prompt: Prettier's test suite has two failing tests, both for the same input file `arrow-chain-with-trailing-comments.js` under `tests/format/js/arrows` (rendered with `arrowParens: always` and `arrowParens: avoid`): a parenthesized arrow chain with a trailing line comment is being formatted incorrectly, because a comment is attached to the wrong node. Find the root cause in the source and fix it. Do not modify any test file or snapshot file. Run the test suite with `npm test` and confirm every test passes before you finish.
